headline: Nubank restores crypto operations after third-party supplier failure
summary: Nubank has normalized its cryptocurrency deposit and withdrawal services following a technical failure at an external supplier. The bank confirmed that customer assets and data remained secure.
why: Nubank is a major digital bank in Latin America, and its crypto services are a significant part of its retail product offering.

impacts.name: Nubank
impacts.why: Operational stability is critical for maintaining customer trust in digital financial services.
